Market today: The mood is cautious. Fed rate hike worries and Nvidia's post-earnings dip, compounded by Jensen Huang's exit, are weighing heavily on your tech and chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-78.62%), MUU (-63.43%), and SMCI (-44.42%) are in deep drawdowns. These, along with other leveraged ETFs, are particularly vulnerable on margin and need immediate attention given their SELL status.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Fed commentary for any shift in rate hike expectations. Also, monitor the broader chip sector's reaction to Nvidia's leadership change.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is under significant pressure; managing risk is paramount.
plays: SOXL: Respect the stop at 200. With -78.62% PnL and SELL status, consider trimming or exiting if it approaches the stop.
MUU: With -63.43% PnL and SELL status, review your stop at 31.6. Leveraged ETFs decay, making deep drawdowns harder to recover.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market sentiment for tech/chips is negative, and your existing leveraged positions require careful management.
